record_original.environment: normal launcher: scripts/dev.py --port 8000, locked venv; real class services at dobolyi.com:9001/9006/9007/9008; server-side .env only (keys never exposed)

generation_observed_live.art: 2 covers created via normal UI (both rendered on cards)
generation_observed_live.music: 2 ACE-Step instrumentals created via normal UI (both played through the DJ player)
generation_observed_live.text: 2 Qwen writing phases observed in the UI
generation_observed_live.speech: 2 Chatterbox speech jobs entered at each transition; audible verification pending

playback_observed.sequence: writing(C) -> playing(C) [~13.6 s] -> writing(H) -> playing(H) [~13.6 s] -> idle

inconclusive_or_not_covered: DJ speaking phase never sampled; controls/replay/reload not executed; exact accounting obstructed by a stale session cookie in the harness; no screenshots; human listening PENDING

runs.retrospective_note: Run 2's live evidence (speech jobs completed but track.speech never attached; no introduction audio in either pass) strongly indicates Run 1 exhibited the SAME underlying defect — its '3 distinct media sources' and absent speaking-phase samples are consistent with the speech job failing server-side in both runs. The Run 1 claim that 'speech media refs created' was not independently confirmed and is now superseded: the introductions never attached in either run.

runs.commit_tested: f3a565d9eeb21b7310a210005b8e78e14d4d2437 (draft PR #27, Stage-1 exclusivity fix included)
runs.environment: normal launcher: scripts/dev.py --port 8000, locked venv; real class services; corrected driver (page-context session reads, track-ID identity checks, audio event instrumentation, 150ms sampler)

prerequisites.real_config: all four services live-probed HTTP 200, keys server-side only

confirmed_live: Both tracks generated through the normal UI with REAL ACE-Step audio (2,304,078 bytes each) and REAL FLUX covers (787,271 bytes each); all 4 creation jobs SUCCEEDED
Both covers and both songs serve real media through the app's own media route
Queue playback: writing phase -> music for both tracks, automatic advancement, clean end, no overlap, single audio element
DJ speaking phase: exactly ONE 150ms sample observed (the brief window before the speech job failed and music started)
Music-only playback is fully sequential (event-level loadstart/playing/ended per song, 12s each)

defect_found.observation: Both speech jobs entered and the job list shows 2 speech entries after pass 1, BUT track.speech stayed None for BOTH tracks; the DJ introduction never played; events show only the two music sources; replay RE-CREATED the speech jobs (2 -> 4), i.e. the failed attachment bypassed the commentary cache and triggered extra Qwen+Chatterbox submissions
defect_found.mechanism: The speech job path (sessions.generate_dj_speech) failed before attaching the speech MediaRef - most plausibly at the real-provider adapter boundary (Qwen text validation or Chatterbox WAV validation in providers._wav). The engine then correctly fell back to music-only (best-effort design), but the controller's replay path treats a missing track.speech as 'generate the introduction', which is correct for a first failure and wrong under a persistent adapter failure (it re-submits on every replay)
defect_found.exact_adapter_cause: NOT DETERMINED - the server swallows provider errors into the job record and the session cookie was not preserved for post-run forensics; pinning it needs one diagnostic Qwen+Chatterbox adapter call, which is NOT authorized by the current budget
defect_found.first_run_correlation: Strongly consistent with Run 1's missing speaking phases and 3-of-4 media sources

request_accounting.budget_status: EXCEEDED for Qwen/Chatterbox (4 each vs 2 authorized): the pass used 2+2 intended; the replay control test - authorized as a no-additional-generation pass - triggered 2+2 MORE because the speech-attachment failure voided the commentary cache. No retry was performed; the run aborted at the first control step after this was detected. This is reported as a defect consequence, not an authorized increase.

runs.control_tests: NOT completed - the driver aborted after detecting the speech-attachment failure (pause/resume/skip/reload/exclusivity passes were not run on this session)
runs.at07: FAIL - real Qwen/Chatterbox end-to-end introduces broken: no speech media attached, no introduction audible; default-voice behavior unverifiable in this state
runs.at09: FAIL (partial) - music-only sequencing, auto-advance, single-element no-overlap verified; speech-phase controls and reload/exclusivity paths not acceptance-verifiable while introductions never attach
runs.human_listening: PENDING - no speech audio exists to listen to
runs.screenshots: not captured (driver aborted at the first control step)
runs.action_taken: Stopped. No retry, no further generation, no code changes during the run. Server stopped, evidence recorded.

defect_correction_proposal: 1. Diagnostic (one Qwen + one Chatterbox adapter call, separate authorization): capture the exact failure (finish_reason / model echo / WAV header|frames / content-type) at the providers.text or providers.speech boundary and fix the adapter validation to accept the REAL service contract.

2. Replay/cache guard: the controller should not re-submit commentary on replay for a track whose speech job already FAILED (distinguish 'never requested' from 'requested and failed') - prevents the budget-amplifying regeneration; regression-tested.
3. Verify the fixed flow with one more bounded live run (fresh 2+2+2+2 authorization), including the control matrix and listening.
